_about: Role-ranking weights and thresholds (QART_NEXT_STEPS §5.3–5.5). Every value is a DECLARED design choice from the spec, not fitted to data; tune only until the persona tests pass, and flag a persona expectation that seems wrong instead of bending the formula. Changed 2026-10-23 (team decision on persona p1): a different role in the same family counts as a nearby move, adjacent.same 0.6 -> 0.9. Scenarios (Domain 1 must-have 6): both are DECLARED assumptions, estimates and not predictions. exposure = share of a role's core weight AI can increasingly do on its own (skills.json ai_exposure: high 1, medium 0.5, low 0); the fast scenario subtracts exposure_penalty x exposure points.

moderate.label: Moderate AI disruption
moderate.description: AI adoption keeps today's pace: today's trend labels, the spec's weights.

fast.label: Fast AI disruption
fast.description: AI takes over routine work sooner: market momentum counts more, and roles built on skills AI can increasingly do on its own lose up to 15 points.
